items.text: where is the search button after the recent update ? I can't find it anywhere ... google website docs page say At the bottom, tap Search.

Go into the search bar in GP in browser and then select show more in the middle section. Should be right at the bottom.

Doesn't sound particularly serious after reading your subsequent posts. Find them and put them in an album called pictures of myself. Good luck.
